# Ezekiel 11 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 11:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | 'And-I-will-bring-you-out from-her-midst, and-I-will-give-you into-the-hand-of strangers, and-I-will-execute judgments against-you. |
| LOGOS | And I will bring you out of the midst of it, and give you into the hands of foreigners, and execute judgments upon you. |
| PNEUMA | I will force you out of this city, hand you over to foreigners, and execute judgment on you. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 11:18 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-shall-come there, and-they-shall-remove all her-detestable-things and-all her-abominations from-her. |
| LOGOS | And when they come there, they will remove from it all its detestable things and all its abominations. |
| PNEUMA | When they return, they will remove every disgusting idol and detestable practice from the land. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 11:20 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | so-that in-My-statutes they-walk and-My-judgments they-keep and-do-them; and-they-shall-be to-Me for-a-people, and-I will-be to-them for-God. |
| LOGOS | that they may walk in My statutes and keep My rules and obey them. And they shall be My people, and I will be their God. |
| PNEUMA | so that they will follow My laws and carefully keep My commands. They will be My people, and I will be their God. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 11:23 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-glory-of YHWH went-up from-upon the-midst-of the-city, and-stood upon the-mountain which [is] to-the-east-of the-city. |
| LOGOS | And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain that is on the east side of the city. |
| PNEUMA | And the glory of the LORD rose from over the city and stopped above the mountain east of it. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 11:25 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-spoke to the-exiles all the-things-of YHWH which He-showed-me. |
| LOGOS | And I told the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me. |
| PNEUMA | I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 11:16 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Though I-removed-them-far among-the-nations, and-though I-scattered-them among-the-lands, yet-I-have-been to-them a-sanctuary [for]-a-little-while in-the-lands where they-have-gone.' |
| LOGOS | Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: Though I removed them far off among the nations, and though I scattered them among the countries, yet I have been a sanctuary to them for a little while in the countries where they have gone.' |
| PNEUMA | So tell them this: The Lord GOD says: 'Yes, I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them across many countries. But I Myself have been a sanctuary for them — a little temple — wherever they've gone.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
